## Workspace Home

Rails IN OBLIGATION ORDER: things someone is waiting on first (acknowledgements), then breach risk, then the rest — and the first rail's action is the page's ONE primary button. Takes query results and actions; contains no domain strings.

```gts
<WorkspaceHome @greeting='Morning, Dana' @identity='on duty' @rails={{this.rails}} />
```

Each rail is `{ title, items, emptyLabel? }`, and an item can carry one action.

The linked example shows a support desk's home: escalations awaiting acknowledgement, then cases nearest breach.

### Non-goals

Not a dashboard (no metrics; Command Center owns those); not navigation chrome.
